mapper.sql: cs.id AS id, cs.code AS code, cs.case_title AS caseTitle, cs.summary AS summary, csd.crm_support_pipeline_setting_id AS pipelineId, csps.description AS pipelineName, csd.crm_support_stag_id AS stageId, css.name AS stageName, csd.probability AS probability, csps.type_id AS typeId, CASE csps.type_id WHEN 1 THEN 'Internal' WHEN 2 THEN 'External' END AS typeName, cs.customer_id AS organizationId, customers.name AS organizationName, cs.priority_id AS priorityId, hr_todo_list_priorities.name AS priorityName, cs.assigned_to AS assignedTo, CONCAT(assigned.first_name, ' ', assigned.last_name) AS assignedToName, cs.customer_contact_id AS contactId, customer_contacts.contact_name AS contactName, ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(egroups.name SEPARATOR ', ') FROM egroups WHERE egroups.id IN ( SELECT egroup_id FROM crm_support_egroups WHERE crm_support_id = cs.id ) ) AS employeeGroupName, cs.created AS created, CONCAT(creator.first_name, ' ', creator.last_name) AS createdBy, cs.modified AS modified, CONCAT(modifier.first_name, ' ', modifier.last_name) AS modifiedBy

FROM crm_supports AS cs LEFT JOIN crm_support_details AS csd ON csd.crm_support_id = cs.id AND csd.is_active = 1 AND csd.is_convert = 0 LEFT JOIN crm_support_pipeline_settings AS csps ON csps.id = csd.crm_support_pipeline_setting_id LEFT JOIN crm_support_stags AS css ON css.id = csd.crm_support_stag_id LEFT JOIN customers ON customers.id = cs.customer_id LEFT JOIN customer_contacts ON customer_contacts.id = cs.customer_contact_id LEFT JOIN hr_todo_list_priorities ON hr_todo_list_priorities.id = cs.priority_id LEFT JOIN users AS assigned ON assigned.id = cs.assigned_to LEFT JOIN users AS creator ON creator.id = cs.created_by LEFT JOIN users AS modifier ON modifier.id = cs.modified_by
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_supports ( case_title, summary, priority_id, customer_id, customer_contact_id, assigned_to, created, created_by, is_active ) VALUES ( #{support.caseTitle}, #{support.summary}, #{support.priorityId}, #{support.customerId}, #{support.customerContactId}, #{support.assignedTo}, NOW(), #{support.createdBy}, #{support.isActive} )
mapper.update: UPDATE crm_supports SET case_title = #{support.caseTitle}, summary = #{support.summary}, priority_id = #{support.priorityId}, customer_id = #{support.customerId}, customer_contact_id = #{support.customerContactId}, assigned_to = #{support.assignedTo}, modified = NOW(), modified_by = #{support.modifiedBy} WHERE id = #{support.id} AND is_active = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_support_details ( crm_support_id, crm_support_pipeline_setting_id, crm_support_stag_id, probability, created, created_by, is_active, is_convert ) VALUES ( #{detail.supportId}, #{detail.pipelineId}, #{detail.stageId}, #{detail.probability}, NOW(), #{detail.createdBy}, #{detail.isActive}, 0 )
mapper.select: SELECT percent FROM crm_support_pipeline_setting_stags WHERE crm_support_stag_id = #{stageId} ORDER BY ordering ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT csd.id AS id, csd.crm_support_pipeline_setting_id AS pipelineId, csd.crm_support_stag_id AS stageId, css.name AS stageName, csd.probability AS probability, cspss.ordering AS ordering, cspss.is_skippable AS skippable, csd.description AS description FROM crm_support_details AS csd INNER JOIN crm_support_pipeline_setting_stags AS cspss ON cspss.crm_support_pipeline_setting_id = csd.crm_support_pipeline_setting_id AND cspss.crm_support_stag_id = csd.crm_support_stag_id LEFT JOIN crm_support_stags AS css ON css.id = csd.crm_support_stag_id WHERE csd.crm_support_id = #{supportId} AND csd.is_active = 1 AND csd.is_convert = 0 ORDER BY csd.id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT cspss.crm_support_stag_id AS stageId, css.name AS stageName, cspss.percent AS percent, cspss.ordering AS ordering FROM crm_support_pipeline_setting_stags AS cspss LEFT JOIN crm_support_stags AS css ON css.id = cspss.crm_support_stag_id WHERE cspss.crm_support_pipeline_setting_id = #{pipelineId} AND cspss.ordering = #{ordering} LIMIT 1

SELECT nextStage.crm_support_stag_id AS stageId, css.name AS stageName, nextStage.percent AS percent, nextStage.ordering AS ordering FROM crm_support_pipeline_setting_stags AS currentStage INNER JOIN crm_support_pipeline_setting_stags AS nextStage ON nextStage.crm_support_pipeline_setting_id = currentStage.crm_support_pipeline_setting_id AND nextStage.ordering = currentStage.ordering + 1 LEFT JOIN crm_support_stags AS css ON css.id = nextStage.crm_support_stag_id WHERE currentStage.crm_support_pipeline_setting_id = #{pipelineId} AND currentStage.crm_support_stag_id = #{stageId} LIMIT 1

SELECT previousStage.crm_support_stag_id AS stageId, css.name AS stageName, previousStage.percent AS percent, previousStage.ordering AS ordering FROM crm_support_pipeline_setting_stags AS currentStage INNER JOIN crm_support_pipeline_setting_stags AS previousStage ON previousStage.crm_support_pipeline_setting_id = currentStage.crm_support_pipeline_setting_id AND previousStage.ordering = currentStage.ordering - 1 LEFT JOIN crm_support_stags AS css ON css.id = previousStage.crm_support_stag_id WHERE currentStage.crm_support_pipeline_setting_id = #{pipelineId} AND currentStage.crm_support_stag_id = #{stageId} LIMIT 1

SELECT cspss.crm_support_stag_id AS stageId, css.name AS stageName, cspss.percent AS percent, cspss.ordering AS ordering FROM crm_support_pipeline_setting_stags AS cspss LEFT JOIN crm_support_stags AS css ON css.id = cspss.crm_support_stag_id WHERE cspss.crm_support_pipeline_setting_id = #{pipelineId} AND cspss.crm_support_stag_id = #{stageId} LIMIT 1

SELECT cspss.crm_support_stag_id AS stageId, css.name AS stageName, cspss.percent AS percent, cspss.ordering AS ordering FROM crm_support_pipeline_setting_stags AS cspss INNER JOIN crm_support_stags AS css ON css.id = cspss.crm_support_stag_id WHERE css.is_active = 1 AND cspss.crm_support_pipeline_setting_id = #{pipelineId} AND cspss.ordering > #{ordering} AND cspss.crm_support_pipeline_setting_id IN ( SELECT crm_support_pipeline_setting_id FROM crm_support_pipeline_setting_egroups WHERE egroup_id IN ( SELECT egroup_id FROM employee_egroups WHERE employee_id IN (SELECT id FROM employees WHERE user_id = #{userId}) ) ) ORDER BY cspss.ordering ASC

SELECT csa.id AS id, csa.name AS name, CASE WHEN activeActivity.crm_support_activity_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS selected FROM crm_support_activities AS csa LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT crm_support_activity_id FROM crm_support_activity_details WHERE crm_support_id = #{supportId} AND is_active = 1 ) AS activeActivity ON activeActivity.crm_support_activity_id = csa.id WHERE csa.is_active = 1 AND csa.id IN ( SELECT crm_support_activity_id FROM crm_support_stag_activities WHERE crm_support_stag_id = #{stageId} ) AND csa.id IN ( SELECT crm_support_activity_id FROM crm_support_activity_egroups WHERE egroup_id IN ( SELECT egroup_id FROM employee_egroups WHERE employee_id IN (SELECT id FROM employees WHERE user_id = #{userId}) ) ) ORDER BY csa.id ASC

SELECT cst.id AS id, cst.name AS name, cst.crm_support_activity_id AS activityId, csa.name AS activityName, CASE WHEN activeTask.crm_support_task_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS selected FROM crm_support_tasks AS cst INNER JOIN crm_support_activities AS csa ON csa.id = cst.crm_support_activity_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT crm_support_task_id FROM crm_support_task_details WHERE crm_support_id = #{supportId} AND is_active = 1 ) AS activeTask ON activeTask.crm_support_task_id = cst.id WHERE cst.is_active = 1 AND csa.id IN ( SELECT crm_support_activity_id FROM crm_support_stag_activities WHERE crm_support_stag_id = #{stageId} ) ORDER BY csa.id ASC, cst.crm_support_activity_id ASC

SELECT logData.id AS id, logData.type AS type, logData.status AS status, logData.statusName AS statusName, CONCAT(IFNULL(logData.createdBy, ''), ': ', logData.statusName) AS title, logData.description AS description, logData.borderColor AS borderColor, logData.created AS created, logData.createdBy AS createdBy FROM ( SELECT csl.id AS id, csl.type AS type, csl.status AS status, CASE csl.type WHEN 1 THEN CASE WHEN csl.status = 1 THEN 'Created New' ELSE 'Update' END WHEN 2 THEN 'Created Activity New' WHEN 3 THEN 'Created Task New' WHEN 4 THEN 'Back Stage' WHEN 5 THEN 'Skip Stage' WHEN 6 THEN 'Save Stage' ELSE '' END AS statusName, csl.description AS description, CASE csl.type WHEN 1 THEN 'border-left: 3px solid #5c88f7;' WHEN 2 THEN 'border-left: 3px solid #1df541;' WHEN 3 THEN 'border-left: 3px solid #f2ee0f;' WHEN 4 THEN 'border-left: 3px solid #fc0324;' WHEN 5 THEN 'border-left: 3px solid #ffa203;' WHEN 6 THEN 'border-left: 3px solid #5c88f7;' ELSE '' END AS borderColor, DATE_FORMAT(csl.created, '%d/%m/%Y %H:%i:%s') AS created, CONCAT(creator.first_name, ' ', creator.last_name) AS createdBy FROM crm_support_logs AS csl LEFT JOIN users AS creator ON creator.id = csl.created_by WHERE csl.crm_support_id = #{supportId} ) AS logData ORDER BY logData.id DESC
SELECT crm_support_activity_id FROM crm_support_activity_details WHERE crm_support_id = #{supportId} AND is_active = 1
SELECT crm_support_task_id FROM crm_support_task_details WHERE crm_support_id = #{supportId} AND is_active = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE crm_support_activity_details SET is_active = 2 WHERE crm_support_id = #{supportId} AND is_active = 1
UPDATE crm_support_task_details SET is_active = 2 WHERE crm_support_id = #{supportId} AND is_active = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_support_activity_details ( crm_support_id, crm_support_stag_id, crm_support_activity_id, created, created_by, is_active ) VALUES ( #{supportId}, #{stageId}, #{activityId}, NOW(), #{userId}, 1 )
INSERT INTO crm_support_task_details ( crm_support_id, crm_support_stag_id, crm_support_task_id, created, created_by, is_active ) VALUES ( #{supportId}, #{stageId}, #{taskId}, NOW(), #{userId}, 1 )
mapper.select: SELECT name FROM crm_support_activities WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
SELECT name FROM crm_support_tasks WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE crm_support_details SET is_convert = 1, converted = NOW(), converted_by = #{userId}, is_skip = 1, skipped = NOW(), skipped_by = #{userId} WHERE crm_support_id = #{supportId}
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM crm_support_details WHERE crm_support_id = #{supportId} AND crm_support_stag_id = #{stageId} AND is_active = 1 AND is_convert = 1 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_support_logs ( crm_support_id, type, status, description, created, created_by ) VALUES ( #{supportId}, #{type}, #{status}, #{description}, NOW(), #{userId} )
